words.origin: 古法语 flexible ← 拉丁语 flexibilis ← flectere（弯折）；与「读、拾取」那一支只是拼写相含，不同源
words.native_definition: able to bend easily, or able to change to suit new conditions
words.core_concept: bending without breaking – 弯得过去而不折断
words.core_image: 一根细钢丝，两头一捏就绕成圆圈，松手又弹回原样
examples: Rubber is more flexible than glass.
We need a more flexible schedule.
semantic_expansions: 易弯曲的：本义，受力就顺着弯，不折断
灵活的：人和安排也能这样顺着情况改
可变通的：规定留有余地，不是一条道走到底
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: forc（fortis 强壮、有力）→ 使对面松动的那股劲；把这股劲压在人身上 → 逼着他动
words.origin: 古法语 force ← 通俗拉丁语 *fortia ← 拉丁语 fortis（强壮的）
words.native_definition: strength or energy used to move something, or to make someone act unwillingly
words.core_concept: strength that makes something give way – 让对面松动的那股劲
words.core_image: 两个人肩膀顶住门板往里推，门轴吱一声，整扇板弹开
examples: The force of the wind broke the window.
They forced him to sign the paper.
semantic_expansions: 力量：推得动东西的那股劲本身
武力：这股劲用在人身上，带打的意思
强迫：把劲压过去，对方不情愿也得动
部队：专门备着这股劲的一群人，air force 即空中那一支

words.origin: 古法语 fondacion ← 拉丁语 fundatio ← fundare（奠基），由名词 fundus（底、地基）派生；fundus 与 fundere（倒出）是两个不同的拉丁词，故不并入库中 fundere 那一族
words.native_definition: the lowest supporting part of a building, or the basis on which something rests
words.core_concept: the bottom that everything above rests on – 上面全部分量落在的那个底
words.core_image: 楼还没起，先在坑里灌出一整片平实的底盘，上头的分量全压在它身上
examples: The foundation of the house is solid concrete.
His argument has no factual foundation.
semantic_expansions: 地基：本义，垫在楼下面的那一层
基础：说法、学问也有这样一个垫底的部分
根据：话站不站得住，看底下垫的是什么
基金会：一笔钱垫在底下长期供着一桩事
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 fundus（底、地基、田产），动词 fundare 由它派生；fundus 与 fundere（倒出）是两个不同的拉丁词，本词不属库中 fundere 那一族
words.native_definition: a sum of money kept for a particular purpose, or to provide money for something
words.core_concept: a store set aside at the bottom – 垫在底下备着的那一笔
words.core_image: 账上那笔钱单独存成一堆，谁动都得先说明用处，用一笔就少一笔
examples: The school set up a fund for books.
The government funds this research.
semantic_expansions: 资金：办事垫在底下的那笔钱
基金：这笔钱圈出来专供一桩事，不挪用
储备：不限于钱，知识、词汇也能这样存着
提供资金：作动词，把这笔垫底的钱拨过去
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 盎格鲁-诺曼语 gardin ← 法兰克语 *gardō（围起来的地方），与英语 yard 同出一源；与库中 wardon 那一族是两个不同的词，只是同出日耳曼语
words.native_definition: a piece of enclosed ground used for growing flowers or vegetables
words.core_concept: a patch of ground fenced off for growing – 围起来种东西的那块地
words.core_image: 一圈篱笆围出一块地，里面分成几畦，畦上蹲着人在拔草
examples: She grows tomatoes in her garden.
The children played in the back garden.
semantic_expansions: 花园：围起来的这块地，种的是看的东西
菜园：同一块地，种的是吃的东西
words.decomposable_note: 源头在日耳曼语支，经法语回流入英语，本项目未为其词族建根

words.root_logic: gram（graphein 刻写）→ 写下来的一行字 → 关于字怎么摆的学问
words.origin: 中古英语 gramere ← 古法语 gramaire ← 拉丁语 grammatica ← 希腊语 gramma（写下的一行字），gramma 由 graphein（刻写）派生；库中 glamor 与本词是同源双式
words.native_definition: the rules by which words are put together in a language
words.core_concept: the rules for setting written words in order – 把写下的字句摆对位置的那套规矩
words.core_image: 写下的字句摆成有定数的次序，哪个词放哪儿都不能随意挪
examples: English grammar has many irregular verbs.
She bought a grammar to check the rules.
semantic_expansions: 语法：字句摆放的那套规矩本身
语法书：把这套规矩收成一本，作可数名词

words.origin: 中古英语 flusshen（惊起、猛涌），更早词源不明；一说与 flash 同支，一说是 flowen（流）与 guschen（涌）的混合
words.native_definition: to clean with a sudden flow of water, to turn red in the face, or set level with a surface
words.core_concept: a sudden rush that sweeps across a surface – 一股突然漫过表面的涌流
words.core_image: 按下把手，一股水兜着盆底转一圈全带走；人一急，血也这么涌上脸
examples: Please flush the toilet after use.
Her cheeks flushed when he spoke.
semantic_expansions: 冲水：水猛地涌过去，把东西带走
脸红：血也这么一下涌上来，面上发热
齐平的：涌流漫平了那个面，两边一样高，不留台阶
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古法语 fracture ← 拉丁语 fractura（断口）← frangere（打断），过去分词 fractus
words.native_definition: a break or crack, especially in a bone
words.core_concept: a clean break running through solid material – 硬东西上裂开的那道断口
words.core_image: 片子上那根白骨中段有一道细黑线，两头对得上，但已经分开
examples: She suffered a fracture in her left arm.
Cold weather can fracture the pipes.
semantic_expansions: 骨折：这道断口出在骨头上
裂缝：出在别的硬物上，就是一道缝
断裂：作动词，硬物受力裂开的那个过程
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 fragmentum（打碎后剩下的一块）← frangere（打断）
words.native_definition: a small piece broken off from something whole
words.core_concept: a piece broken off a whole – 从整体上碎下来的一块
words.core_image: 杯子摔在地上，捡起来的是十几块带尖角的瓷，拼不回原来的圆
examples: He found a fragment of old pottery.
I heard only a fragment of their talk.
semantic_expansions: 碎片：实物碎下来的那一块
片段：话、乐曲、记忆碎下来的一段，同一个道理
破裂：作动词，整块变成许多小块
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 frequent ← 拉丁语 frequens（挤得满、来得密的）
words.native_definition: happening or appearing often, at short intervals
words.core_concept: coming again at short intervals – 隔不了多久又来一趟
words.core_image: 这条路上的车一辆接一辆，前一辆还没出视线，后一辆就到了
examples: He is a frequent visitor to our office.
Frequent rain spoiled the whole holiday.
semantic_expansions: 频繁的：两次之间的间隔短，密
经常的：同一件事，中文里更常这么说
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古法语 fourniture（供给、置办）← fournir（供给）← 法兰克语 *frumjan（完成、提供）
words.native_definition: the movable objects such as tables, chairs and beds put in a room
words.core_concept: what is supplied to fill out a room – 把一间屋添齐所需的那些东西
words.core_image: 搬进来的床、桌、柜一件件落到位，屋里从空荡变成能住人
examples: They bought new furniture for the flat.
The furniture is made of solid oak.
words.decomposable_note: 源头在日耳曼语支，经法语回流入英语，本项目未为其词族建根

words.root_logic: gentil（gentilis 同一族的、出身好的）← gens 与 genus 同支 → 出身好 → 举止有教养 → 出手不带狠劲
words.origin: 中古英语 gentil ← 古法语 gentil（出身高贵的）← 拉丁语 gentilis（同族的）← gens（氏族），与 genus 同出印欧语 *ǵenh₁-
words.native_definition: kind and careful in the way you act, and not strong or sudden in effect
words.core_concept: handling things without any harshness – 出手不带一点狠劲
words.core_image: 他伸手把小鸟捧起来，指头一点没收紧，动作慢得像怕碰碎
examples: He has a gentle voice and slow speech.
A gentle slope led down to the river.
semantic_expansions: 温和的：人的脾气和态度不带火气
轻柔的：手上的力道很轻，怕伤着
和缓的：坡度、变化也这样，不陡不急

words.root_logic: geo-（希腊语 ge 大地）+ -logy（logos 话里的条理）→ 把大地的构成讲出条理的那门学问
words.origin: 现代拉丁语 geologia，由希腊语 ge（大地）与 logos（话语、条理）合成
words.native_definition: the study of the rocks and layers that make up the earth
words.core_concept: a reasoned account of how the earth is made – 把大地的构成讲出条理
words.core_image: 敲开一块石头看里面的层，一层压一层，能读出这地方几万年的事
examples: He studies the geology of the Alps.
The geology here is mostly limestone.
semantic_expansions: 地质学：讲大地构成的那门学问
地质：某一处地下实际的构成情况，不指学科

words.origin: 古法语 glorious ← 拉丁语 gloriosus ← gloria（荣耀、盛名）
words.native_definition: deserving great praise, or splendid to look at
words.core_concept: lit up by praise or by beauty – 被称赞或美景照亮
words.core_image: 他举着旗跑完最后一圈，看台上人全站起来，太阳正好落在他背后
examples: They won a glorious victory that day.
We had three glorious days by the sea.
semantic_expansions: 光荣的：众人的称赞照在身上
壮丽的：这种光落在景物上，看着让人肃然
极好的：日子、天气也用它夸，口语里的加强说法
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 希腊语 gumnasion（练身的场所）← gumnos（赤身，希腊运动员裸身训练），经拉丁语 gymnasium 入英语
words.native_definition: a large room or building with equipment for physical exercise
words.core_concept: a place set aside for training the body – 专供练身子的一处场所
words.core_image: 一间高顶大屋，地板划着线，墙边码着垫子和杠铃，说话有回音
examples: The school has a new gymnasium.
We train in the gymnasium every morning.
semantic_expansions: 体育馆：整栋供比赛和上课的大屋
健身房：同一类场所里偏小的一间，供个人练
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 findan（找到、遇上）← 原始日耳曼语 *finþaną
words.native_definition: to discover something by searching or by chance, or to reach a judgement
words.core_concept: coming upon the thing you were after – 摸着了原本要的那样东西
words.core_image: 口袋里摸了三遍都没有，最后在沙发缝里碰到那个硬角
examples: I found my keys under the sofa.
The court found him guilty of theft.
semantic_expansions: 找到：原本要的那样东西到手了
发现：不一定在找，碰上了新情况
认为：想法上也这样撞见一个结论
判定：法庭把这个结论正式定下来
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 finger ← 原始日耳曼语 *fingraz ← 印欧语 *penkʷrós，出自 *pénkʷe（五），与 five 同源
words.native_definition: one of the five parts at the end of the hand, or to touch something with them
words.core_concept: one of the five that reach out from the hand – 从手上伸出去的那五根之一
words.core_image: 手掌前端伸出五根短枝，各自能弯下去，尖上有一圈细纹
examples: She cut her finger on the tin lid.
He fingered the cloth to feel its weight.
semantic_expansions: 手指：手末端伸出的那五根
指状物：细长而伸出来的东西也这么叫，如 a finger of land
用手指碰：作动词，用这五根去摸、去拨
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: fire（火）+ place（platea 东西落定的位置）→ 屋里专门留给火的那块位置
words.origin: 由 fire（古英语 fȳr，火）与 place 复合而成；place 出自古法语 place ← 拉丁语 platea（宽街、场地）
words.native_definition: an opening in the wall of a room where a fire can be lit
words.core_concept: the spot in a room kept for fire – 屋里留给火的那块位置
words.core_image: 墙上凿出一个方口，里头架着木柴，上方一道烟道直通屋顶
examples: A log fire burned in the fireplace.
They hung stockings above the fireplace.

words.origin: 英语 fit 加 -ing 构成；fit 出自中古英语 fit（对等的对手），更早词源不明
words.native_definition: suitable for the occasion, a session to try on clothes, or a small attached part
words.core_concept: matching the place it goes into – 和该进的那个位置刚好对上
words.core_image: 盖子扣上去，边和边对齐，没有一处翘起，转一圈也不松
examples: A quiet dinner was a fitting end.
She went for a fitting at the tailor.
semantic_expansions: 合适的：场合与做法对得上，不别扭
试穿：把衣服往身上对一次，看合不合
配件：装到主件上刚好对得上的那个小零件
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 follow 加 -ing 构成；follow 出自古英语 folgian（跟在后面走）← 原始日耳曼语 *fulgōjan
words.native_definition: coming next after this one, after, or the group of supporters someone has
words.core_concept: whatever comes directly behind – 紧跟在后头出现的那个
words.core_image: 名单上这一行读完，下一行紧贴着排在后头；队尾也拖着一串人
examples: The following day the weather turned cold.
He has a large following on social media.
semantic_expansions: 下列的：文字里排在后面的那些内容
接着的：时间上紧排在后面的那一个
之后：作介词，某事完了紧接着
追随者：贴在后面跟着走的那群人
collocations: following sth —— 在某事之后，多指紧接着发生，比 after 正式
the following + n —— 下列的、以下的，用来引出接着要列的内容
a large/wide following —— 一大批追随者，指支持者的规模
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 foresēon，由 fore-（在前）与 sēon（看）合成
words.native_definition: to know or expect that something will happen before it does
words.core_concept: seeing a thing before it arrives – 事情到之前先看见它
words.core_image: 天边云压下来，他先把晒的衣服收进屋，半小时后果然下雨
examples: No one could foresee the sudden crash.
We foresee delays in the next stage.
semantic_expansions: 预见：提前看出会发生什么
预料：同一件事，语气偏平常，常用于否定句
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 forth（往前、出来）与 coming 复合；forth 出自古英语 forþ ← 原始日耳曼语 *furþa-
words.native_definition: about to happen soon, available when needed, or willing to give information
words.core_concept: on its way out into view – 正往前露出头来
words.core_image: 海报上印着下月的日期，票已经开卖；问他细节，他也一句句说出来
examples: Details of the forthcoming trip are online.
He was not forthcoming about his plans.
semantic_expansions: 即将到来的：事情正往前走，快露头了
现成的：要的东西已经递到手边，不用等
愿意讲的：话也这样往外送，多用于否定
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 古英语 fōstor（食物、养育）← 原始日耳曼语 *fōstrą（养料），与 food 同支
words.native_definition: to bring up a child that is not your own, or to help something develop
words.core_concept: feeding something along until it grows – 一口口喂着，让它长起来
words.core_image: 孩子不是自己生的，饭一顿顿喂，衣服一件件添，慢慢带大
examples: They fostered two boys for six years.
The school fosters a love of reading.
semantic_expansions: 养育：把别人的孩子接过来喂大
培养：兴趣、能力也这样一点点喂着长
助长：坏事也能被这么喂着变大，带贬义
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 fulfillen ← 古英语 fullfyllan（填到满），由 full（满）与 fyllan（使满）合成
words.native_definition: to do what was promised or required, or to make something come true
words.core_concept: filling a commitment right up to the top – 把答应下的事填到满
words.core_image: 清单上答应过的事一条条打勾，最后一条也划掉，纸上再无空项
examples: He fulfilled his promise to her.
The job does not fulfil her at all.
semantic_expansions: 履行：答应的、该做的，一项项填满
实现：愿望、计划也这样填成真的
满足：人心里那块空处被填上，才觉得够
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: gentle（gentilis 出身好的）+ man（人）→ 出身好的男人 → 举止得体的男人
words.origin: 中古英语 gentilman，由 gentil（出身高贵）与 man 复合；gentil ← 古法语 gentil ← 拉丁语 gentilis（同族的）← gens（氏族）
words.native_definition: a man who behaves politely and honourably towards others
words.core_concept: a man whose bearing shows good breeding – 举止里看得出出身的男人
words.core_image: 他替后面的人扶住门，等人都进去才自己走，全程没抬高过声音
examples: He behaved like a true gentleman all evening.
Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
semantic_expansions: 绅士：举止有分寸、待人有礼的那种男人
男士：称场合里的男客，多用作复数呼语

words.origin: 中古英语 gliteren ← 古诺斯语 glitra（闪亮）← 原始日耳曼语 *glitrōną
words.native_definition: to shine with many small flashes of light
words.core_concept: light broken into many small flashes – 光碎成许多小点在闪
words.core_image: 水面上碎成千百个小亮点，随波一明一暗，晃得人眯眼
examples: Snow glittered in the morning sun.
Her dress was covered in gold glitter.
semantic_expansions: 闪耀：作动词，光碎成小点一下下亮
闪光：作名词，指这种一明一暗的亮本身
亮片：能做出这种效果的那些细碎小片
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 由 grand 与 mother 复合；mother 出自古英语 mōdor ← 原始日耳曼语 *mōdēr，grand 出自古法语 grant（大的，源出拉丁语 grandis）
words.native_definition: the mother of one of your parents
words.core_concept: the mother one generation further back – 往上再数一辈的那位妇人
words.core_image: 比父母再上一辈的那位妇人，头发全白，孙辈围着她要糖
examples: My grandmother lives in the countryside.
She learned to knit from her grandmother.
semantic_expansions: 祖母：父亲那边往上一辈的女性长辈
外祖母：母亲那边同一辈的，中文分开说
奶奶：口语里的叫法，多指父亲那边
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 greet 加 -ing 构成；greet 出自古英语 grētan（接触、招呼）← 西日耳曼语 *grōtjan，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: words or actions used when you meet someone or send good wishes
words.core_concept: the first words passed when two meet – 两人碰面时递出的第一句
words.core_image: 门一开，先递过来一句话和一个点头，然后才谈别的
examples: He raised his hand in greeting.
We sent greetings for the new year.
semantic_expansions: 问候：见面或写信时先说的那一句
招呼：不用说话也算，抬手点头都是
贺词：节日里送出去的那种话，多用复数
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 德语 Hamburger（汉堡的、汉堡人）← 地名 Hamburg，古高地德语 Hammaburg 由 hamma（河湾地）与 burg（城堡）合成；与 ham（火腿）无关
words.native_definition: a round bread roll with a flat cake of cooked minced beef inside
words.core_concept: a flat cake of beef served in a roll – 夹在圆面包里的一块扁肉饼
words.core_image: 两片圆面包夹住一块压扁的煎肉，中间还塞了生菜和一片番茄
examples: He ordered a hamburger and chips.
The hamburger was too salty to finish.
semantic_expansions: 汉堡包：连面包带肉饼的整个吃法
牛肉饼：单指中间那块压扁的肉，不带面包
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
